zh: 一段字符能重排成回文，当且仅当出现奇数次的字符至多一种；删掉一个出现奇数次的字符，奇数种类就减一。
所以一段删至多一个字符后能成回文，等价于该段奇数次字符不超过两种；只需要知道每种字符出现次数的奇偶性。
用 26 位掩码表示奇偶，先求全串掩码；从左到右枚举切点（两段都非空），前缀掩码逐字符异或更新，右段掩码为全串掩码异或前缀掩码；两者 1 的个数都不超过 2 就输出 YES，否则最后输出 NO。
en: A string can be rearranged into a palindrome exactly when at most one character occurs an odd number of times; deleting one odd-count character reduces the number of odd counts by one.
So a part can become a palindrome after deleting at most one character exactly when it has at most two odd-count characters; only the parity of each character's count matters.

Represent parities with a 26-bit mask and compute the mask of the whole string; enumerate the cut from left to right (both parts non-empty), updating the prefix mask with XOR per character, with the right part's mask being the whole mask XOR the prefix mask; if both have at most 2 set bits output YES, otherwise output NO at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain 26-bit parity masks of character frequencies for the whole string and for each prefix ending at a cut. If some cut leaves both sides with at most 2 odd-frequency characters, output YES; otherwise NO.

## Proof of correctness

A multiset can be rearranged into a palindrome exactly when at most one character has an odd frequency. Deleting one odd-frequency character reduces the number of odd frequencies by at most one, so deleting at most once works exactly when the original number of odd frequencies is ≤2. The two parts choose their deletions and arrangements independently, so enumerating every non-empty cut and checking both sides exhausts all possibilities.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(26) excluding the input.
